title: 10 Things a Desperate Man Does (That a Godly Man Won't)
caption:
10 things a desperate man does that a godly man won't. She can always tell the difference.

Texts her first, prays never. Rewrites his whole personality for her attention. Panics at every guy she talks to. A man chasing God doesn't run on that kind of hunger.

Ask God to build the man first. The rest follows.

#faith #christianman #godlymen #datingadvice #manofgod #christiandating #discipleship
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
